newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African police chief bewails state of force.
newsitem.headline: S.African police chief bewails state of force.

text.p: About a third of South Africa's police officers do not have driving licences and 30,000 failed to complete high school, Police Commissioner George Fivaz said on Friday.
Fivaz told a news conference basic training was a priority for the force, saying 45,000 members out of a total of 140,000 did not have licences to drive.
"We've inherited a complete mess," he said, responding to questions about the failure of the police to quell South Africa's spiralling crime rate.

Fivaz was speaking after a parliamentary debate on the police budget for the year. He said most of the 20 percent increase would go to improve salaries for current members of the force and there was not enough money to employ more recruits.
Violent crime in South Africa, including rape, murder and car hijacks, is scaring off investment and foreign tourists and is one of the main causes of an exodus of skilled people.
